patterns.name: Bullish Order Block
patterns.description: Last bearish candle before a strong impulsive rally; price often returns to mitigate this zone before continuing up.
conditions: last opposing candle before impulsive move
followed by strong displacement candles
unmitigated (not yet returned to)
patterns.invalidation: close fully through the block's low

patterns.name: Bearish Order Block
patterns.description: Last bullish candle before a strong impulsive drop; price often returns to mitigate this zone before continuing down.
conditions: last opposing candle before impulsive move
followed by strong displacement candles
unmitigated (not yet returned to)
patterns.invalidation: close fully through the block's high

patterns.name: Bullish Liquidity Sweep
patterns.description: Price briefly breaks below a swing low / equal lows (sell-side liquidity), then reverses sharply back inside the range.
conditions: brief penetration beyond prior swing low
fast rejection candle back inside range
ideally near a discount zone or unmitigated demand order block
patterns.invalidation: sustained close and continuation below the swept low

patterns.name: Bearish Liquidity Sweep
patterns.description: Price briefly breaks above a swing high / equal highs (buy-side liquidity), then reverses sharply back inside the range.
conditions: brief penetration beyond prior swing high
fast rejection candle back inside range
ideally near a premium zone or unmitigated supply order block
patterns.invalidation: sustained close and continuation above the swept high

patterns.name: Bullish Fair Value Gap
patterns.description: Three-candle imbalance during an up-move where candle 1 high and candle 3 low leave a gap; often partially filled before continuation.
conditions: candle 1 wick does not overlap candle 3 wick
formed during impulsive up-move
patterns.invalidation: full close below the gap with continuation lower

patterns.name: Bearish Fair Value Gap
patterns.description: Three-candle imbalance during a down-move; often partially filled before continuation lower.
conditions: candle 1 wick does not overlap candle 3 wick
formed during impulsive down-move
patterns.invalidation: full close above the gap with continuation higher

patterns.name: Bullish Change of Character
patterns.description: First break of structure against a prevailing downtrend (break of the most recent lower high) — early reversal warning, not confirmation.
conditions: prior LH/LL structure
candle closes above most recent lower high
patterns.invalidation: price makes a new low without following through higher
confluence_boost: confirmed shortly after by a BOS higher

patterns.name: Bearish Change of Character
patterns.description: First break of structure against a prevailing uptrend (break of the most recent higher low) — early reversal warning, not confirmation.
conditions: prior HH/HL structure
candle closes below most recent higher low
patterns.invalidation: price makes a new high without following through lower
confluence_boost: confirmed shortly after by a BOS lower
